items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] With Victor Feldman and John Pisano. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh that's right, yeah.

ctx.x: But I never thought it really had much merit, it was watered down East Coast jazz.
But then he would have some of his own groups, you know and he would have people like Victor Feldman and Joe Gordon and…
Oh he had some, he was a wonderful small band drummer…
